_readme: Ratchet baseline recorded from origin/dev on 2026-10-06 (CLAUDE.md §2: visible dates, dateModified and sitemap lastmod agree).
blogDates (test/dateConsistency.test.ts): blog posts whose visible "Last reviewed/updated" date, BlogPosting dateModified and sitemap lastmod disagree, with the dates as recorded.
dateModifiedVsLastmod (scripts/quality-gate.mjs): indexed pages whose JSON-LD dateModified differs from their sitemap lastmod, with both dates.

An entry may only be deleted: a changed date is a new disagreement and fails; a resolved one fails until its entry is deleted. Fix the dates only when the content really changed (never fake freshness).
